tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background on every device. Black pixels are off on an OLED watch. In Day it is white, for sunlight.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tiles, panels and list rows on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A pressed control or the selected row, on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Tracks of bars and rings, separators, the normal band of a gauge. Decoration only: never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The border of a control that has no fill, on ground and surface (at least 3:1 on both).

tokens.name: reading
tokens.usage: Numbers and primary text on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Units, labels and secondary text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: The one loud colour: the primary action, the selected mode, progress. Never a state of the machine or the patient. In Day the pair turns round: a black block with lime text, which stays loud on white.

tokens.name: on-active
tokens.usage: Text and icons on active.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: High priority: act now. A filled block with on-alarm text, three triangles, and a word.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text and icons on alarm.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Medium priority: act soon. A filled block with on-caution text, two triangles, and a word. In Day the block also gets a stroke-bar border in reading, because yellow fades on white.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text and icons on caution.

tokens.name: advice
tokens.usage: Low priority and information: be aware. Text or an outline on ground and surface, one triangle, and a word.

tokens.name: on-advice
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a filled advice block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The module: every size and gap is a multiple of it.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word; inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a number and its bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a tile; between rows of a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between tiles; the margin of a small screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups on a panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The margin of a large panel; the pitch of the stripe pattern.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: tiles, buttons, chips, bars. Signal has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-face
tokens.usage: Only the face of a round display, and rings drawn on it.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: The marker of a gauge and the border of an outlined button.

tokens.name: stroke-track
tokens.usage: A linear bar: range left, level, progress.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: The ring of a round face: setpoint, activity.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target for a bare finger on thermostat, watch and appliance.

tokens.name: target-glove
tokens.usage: The smallest target where gloves are worn: machine panel, EV charger, e-bike (about 20 mm on those screens).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: The height of a mode chip such as ECO or AUTO. It is not a touch target.
